title: On Ruining the whole crop in one night
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：ruin　|　正文 365 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ruin 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the craftsman ① ruined the whole crop in one night without a word of thanks, and every apprentice in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the craftsman ② ruins the whole crop in one night at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ ruin the whole crop in one night at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ ruined the whole crop in one night before — a line in the ledger for August 1956 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Ruining the whole crop in one night without a word of thanks, the craftsman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ ruin the family with one bad year at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Ruin the family with one bad year at once and never mention it again.

By 1969 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new apprentice from the next workshop ⑧ ruins the family with one bad year without a word of thanks every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ ruined the whole crop in one night again when nobody else would.

⑩ To ruin the whole crop in one night, my mother said in 1974, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody ruins the whole crop in one night at once again and somebody must ruin the whole crop in one night without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 毁坏（一般过去式 ruined the whole crop in one night：1962 年匠人头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 毁坏（一般现在 ruins the whole crop in one night：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 毁坏（不定式 to ruin the whole crop in one night：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 毁坏（过去完成时 had ruined the whole crop in one night：1956 年八月的工料簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 毁坏（动名词 ruining the whole crop in one night 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 破产（ruin the family with one bad year：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去破产一个坏年成就让这家人垮了）
G. v. 破产（ruin the family with one bad year：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 毁坏（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 ruins the family with one bad year，而母亲又一次 ruined the whole crop in one night）

answers.why: ruin 意为“毁坏”，1962 年匠人不图一句谢毁坏一夜之间毁了整季庄稼，那是工坊里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 ruined。
ruin 意为“毁坏”，自那以后匠人二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 ruins。
ruin 意为“毁坏”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯毁坏一夜之间毁了整季庄稼”，此处为不定式 to ruin the whole crop in one night。
ruin 意为“毁坏”，工料簿里 八月 那行字说明早在 1969 年之前就有人毁坏过，故用过去完成时 had ruined。
ruin 意为“毁坏”，匠人说“毁坏一夜之间毁了整季庄稼这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 ruining the whole crop in one night 作主语。
ruin 意为“破产”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去破产一个坏年成就让这家人垮了”，should ever 之后用原形 ruin the family with one bad year。
ruin 意为“破产”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻破产一个坏年成就让这家人垮了（ruin the family with one bad year at once），以后再也不要提起。
ruin 意为“毁坏”，新来的学徒每个年头都照例破产一个坏年成就让这家人垮了，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 ruins。
ruin 意为“毁坏”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢毁坏一夜之间毁了整季庄稼，用一般过去式 ruined 叙述。
ruin 意为“毁坏”，结尾那句是母亲 1974 年的话：要毁坏一夜之间毁了整季庄稼，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工坊记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ruin 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the craftsman ruined the whole crop in one night without a word of thanks, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the craftsman ruins the whole crop in one night at once whenever the workshop asks.
Ruining the whole crop in one night without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever ruin the family with one bad year at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next workshop ruins the family with one bad year without a word of thanks every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother ruined the whole crop in one night again, and the workshop remembered that half.
